Odds could be dropping due to a player injury or illness throughout a team, or because one team has potentially decided to play a weaker side ahead of a game. Some online betting sites may take notice, while others may not, allowing you to take advantage before there is any odds movement with certain bookmakers. Check out our page today for all of the best dropping odds tips across several different markets, while you can even filter it to a specific market or sport you are interested in.
